Click an aircraft or press Tab to select one. Keys 1 through 5 toggle engine, radio, radar, fuel leak, and hydraulic failures. R restores the selected plane. Space pauses. Drag to orbit. Scroll to zoom. Home resets the view. H shows help. C hides the interface. The mock probabilities are illustrative, not real aviation predictions.
